meta.note: Dates for the current term come from the academic calendar and department emails. Items marked approximate follow last year's pattern.

links.label: AUS Research
links.desc: Office of Research, IRB and CITI information

links.label: Watermark (Planning & Self-Study)
links.desc: Course files and assurance of learning

events.title: Start-of-year department meeting
events.description: The department meets the week before classes start. It is the best place to meet colleagues and hear the year's priorities.
events.tip: Bring questions about coordinated courses and your syllabus.

events.title: Syllabus due
events.dateText: Template Thu Aug 13; due Tue Aug 18, 2026
events.description: Send your syllabus to the Head of Department (cc the department assistant). For coordinated courses, your course coordinator approves it first.
events.tip: Start from the department template and check the coordinator's shared materials.

events.title: Faculty Research Grant (FRG27) call opens
history: FRG26: RFP Jul 10, 2025; Q&A session Tue Sep 9, 2025, 4 pm
events.description: Internal grants of up to AED 500,000 over two years. Read the call, then plan your proposal and budget with your Head of Department.
events.tip: Attend the Q&A session if one is announced.

events.title: Promotion and rolling contract review notice (FERC)
events.description: Faculty due for promotion or rolling contract review are notified early in the Fall. Check the instructions and prepare your file.
events.tip: Ask your Head of Department what your file should include.

events.title: Department annual report input
events.dateText: Draft Tue Sep 1; additions due Thu Sep 3, 2026
events.description: The department compiles its annual report in the first weeks of the Fall. Send your additions when asked.
events.tip: Keep your Digital Measures record current so this is quick.

events.title: Summer course files and CLO reporting due
events.description: Upload course files and complete assurance of learning (CLO/CAR) for any course you taught in the Summer.
events.tip: Course file guidelines arrive in the end-of-semester email from the Associate Dean.

events.title: Sabbatical applications
events.dateText: Head of Department deadline near end of week 4
history: 2025: HoD Sep 18; Dean Oct 2; Provost Oct 16; committee Nov 20; Chancellor by Jan 30
events.description: Applications move from Head of Department to Dean, Provost, a committee and the Chancellor. Plan early because each step has its own deadline.
events.tip: Talk to your Head of Department in the first weeks of term.

events.title: Conference and Workshop Grant (CWG27), round 1
events.dateText: Pre-submission Tue Sep 15, 2026 (five rounds this year)
history: 2025-26: pre-submission on the 1st of Sep, Nov, Jan, Mar, May; final submission via the Dean's office on the 13th; awards about the 30th; up to AED 75,000
events.description: Funding to present at conferences or run workshops. Rounds repeat through the year, so you can catch a later one.
events.tip: Submit your pre-submission before the round closes, then finalize through the Dean's office.

events.title: FRG27 proposal: PI deadline to the Dean
events.dateText: Thu Oct 1, 2026, 4 pm. School to Research Office: Oct 15, 4 pm
history: Awards announced about March; projects run Jun 1, 2027 to May 31, 2029
events.description: Principal investigators send the proposal to the Dean. The School then submits to the Office of the Vice Chancellor for Research.
events.tip: Allow time for IRB needs and a budget check before October 1.

events.title: SBA Undergraduate Research Grant, round 1
events.description: Supports faculty who involve undergraduate students in research. A second round follows in the Spring.
events.tip: A good first grant to try with a student collaborator.

events.title: Midterm grades for at-risk students
events.description: Enter midterm grades in Banner for students who are struggling, so advisors can reach them early.
events.tip: Faculty Services > Midterm Grades in Banner.

events.title: Commencement faculty attendance
events.description: Faculty are asked to confirm whether they will attend commencement, which is on Dec 20 (tentative).
events.tip: Watch for the email from the Dean's office.

events.title: Advising for Spring
events.dateText: Advising from Nov 2; priority registration Nov 9; withdrawal deadline Nov 16, 2026
events.description: Meet your advisees and clear their advising holds. The Management major map shows the course sequence and prerequisites.
events.tip: Open the major map during the meeting and plan the next two semesters.

events.title: Sharakah Public Speaking Competition
events.description: A student event. Faculty can attend, judge or encourage students to take part.

events.title: Sustainability Research Day
events.description: University event where faculty and students share research on sustainability.
events.tip: A good chance to meet researchers from other schools.

events.title: Student course evaluations open
events.description: Students evaluate courses near the end of term. Encourage them to respond, ideally with class time to do it.
events.tip: Confirm the exact window with the department.

events.title: End-of-term department meeting
events.description: Review the term, grading and next semester's plans.

events.title: End-of-semester email from the Associate Dean
events.description: Attached: final exam policy, CAR form, course file guidelines, upload guidelines and declaration form. Every course needs a scheduled assessment in exam week, and grades are posted on iLearn.
events.tip: Read the attachments before you finalize your exam.

events.title: Enter final grades in Banner
events.dateText: Within 48 hours of each final exam
events.description: Enter grades through Faculty Services > Final Grades. Grades roll to student history at 10 am, Monday to Thursday.
events.tip: Post grades on iLearn as well.

events.title: Fall commencement
events.description: Graduation ceremony for Fall graduates.

events.title: Fall course files and CLO reporting
history: Spring 2026: files due Jun 1; CLO closed Jun 16
Fall 2025 CLO window: Mar 9-15, 2026, extended to Apr 5-12
events.description: Upload course files and complete CLO/CAR for the courses you taught. The date is announced by email each term.
events.tip: Start your CAR as grades are finalized so it is not a rush later.

events.title: Start-of-semester department meeting
events.description: The department meets the week before classes start.

events.title: Syllabus due
events.dateText: Approximate; about the first days of term
events.description: Send your syllabus to the Head of Department (cc the department assistant). For coordinated courses, your course coordinator approves it first.

events.title: Outstanding Research and Creative Works Awards: nominations
events.description: Nominate your own work or a colleague's for the annual research awards.

events.title: Sabbatical decisions
events.dateText: Approximate; Chancellor decision by about Jan 30
events.description: Decisions on Fall sabbatical applications arrive near the end of January.

events.title: SBA Undergraduate Research Grant, round 2
events.description: A second round for faculty who involve undergraduate students in research.

events.title: FRG27 awards announced
events.description: Decisions on the Faculty Research Grant round. Funded projects start Jun 1, 2027.

events.title: Midterm grades for at-risk students
events.description: Enter midterm grades in Banner for students who are struggling.
events.tip: Faculty Services > Midterm Grades.

events.title: Advising for Summer and Fall
events.dateText: Advising from Mar 29; Summer registration Apr 12-18; Fall registration Apr 19-25; withdrawal deadline Apr 22, 2027
history: 2025: department advising week Apr 7-10; advising form signed and sent to the department assistant to remove the Banner hold, before 3 pm Apr 10
events.description: Meet advisees and clear their holds. The Management major map shows the course sequence.
events.tip: Open the major map during the meeting.

events.title: Student course evaluations open
events.description: Encourage your students to complete the evaluations.

events.title: SBA Professional Development Grant
history: 2026: applications Apr 20; awards Apr 30; spend by Aug 31
events.description: Small grant for professional development. Check the spending deadline before you apply.

events.title: Spring CLO reporting opens
events.description: Assurance of learning reporting in Watermark opens before the term ends.

events.title: Annual evaluation opens in Digital Measures
events.description: The SBA Annual Review covers teaching and service from Summer through Spring, and research over a two-year window.
events.tip: Update Digital Measures during the year so you only need to review it.

events.title: End-of-year department meeting
events.description: Review the year and plan ahead.

events.title: End-of-semester email from the Associate Dean
events.description: Attached: final exam policy, CAR form, course file guidelines and declaration form.

events.title: Enter final grades in Banner
events.dateText: Within 48 hours of each final exam
events.description: Faculty Services > Final Grades. Post grades on iLearn as well.

events.title: Spring commencement
events.description: Graduation ceremony for Spring graduates.

events.title: Syllabus due
events.description: Summer terms are short, so send your syllabus as soon as it is ready.

events.title: Spring course files due
events.description: Upload course files for the Spring courses you taught.

events.title: Annual review: faculty submission due
history: 2026: faculty due Jun 1; Head of Department due Jun 15
events.description: Finish your section of the SBA Annual Review in Digital Measures.

events.title: FRG projects begin
events.description: Funded FRG27 projects start. Check your award terms and IRB approvals.

events.title: Spring CLO reporting closes
events.description: Finish your assurance of learning reporting in Watermark.

events.title: Respond to your Head of Department's review
events.description: Read your review in Digital Measures and add a response if you wish.

events.title: Respond to the Dean's report
history: 2026: Dean's report Jul 2; faculty response Jul 4; archiver closes Jul 31
events.description: The Dean's report is released. You can respond before the review is finalized.

events.title: End-of-semester email from the Associate Dean
events.description: Final exam policy, CAR form, course file guidelines and declaration form.

events.title: Enter final grades in Banner
events.dateText: Within 48 hours of each final exam
events.description: Faculty Services > Final Grades.

events.title: Next year's grant calls appear (FRG, CWG, RRG)
history: 2025: FRG26 call Jul 10; CWG26 and RRG26 Jul 14
events.description: Plan your research over the break so your proposal is ready when the Fall call opens.

events.title: Keep Digital Measures current
events.description: Add publications, courses and service as they happen. It feeds your annual review and promotion files.

events.title: IRB approval before collecting data
events.description: Research involving people needs IRB approval first. Check the Office of Research page for forms and training.
events.tip: Apply early. Review times vary.

events.title: Monthly Research Bulletin
events.description: Sent by the Vice Chancellor for Research with funding calls and news.

events.title: Open Access Publishing support (OAP)
events.description: Support for open access fees for accepted manuscripts in top-ranked journals (top 15% in Scopus).

events.title: External research calls
history: Examples: Faya Research Grant, AUS-SNOC Joint Research Program, Swiss-MENA Research Partnership Grants, ADIA Lab
events.description: Outside funders and partners advertise calls through the Research Office during the year.

events.title: SBA "What's On This Week" digest
events.description: A weekly email listing student and school events you can join or promote.

events.title: Management Major Map
events.description: Course sequence and prerequisites for advising any time in the year.
